choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: No, he is a countryman of yours, if a Corsican is a countryman of anyone’s. But you know him, M. de Morcerf.
Is it that excellent M. Bertuccio, who understands hiring windows so well?
I shall wait till I am of age, which will be in about ten months.
